typography.guidelines: Use Cabinet Grotesk for all major headings (H1-H3) and key metric numbers to give a structured, professional, yet distinctive look. Use IBM Plex Sans for body, tables, and dense data, ensuring high legibility. Avoid Inter or Roboto entirely. Tracking should be tight on headings (`tracking-tight`) and normal on body. Apply `font-medium` to table headers.

colors.guidelines: Do not use standard SaaS blue or AI purple gradients. This is a food operations dashboard—colors must feel tactile, earthy, and grounded. The primary brand color is a Deep Terracotta (#A44200) used sparingly for key CTAs. Status colors (Sage Green, Warning Ochre) must be used functionally to indicate health and variance.

layouts.dashboard: Collapsible left-sidebar navigation with a top-header for context (Current Cycle, Outlet). The main content area should use a 'Bento' or high-density grid approach for summaries.
layouts.spacing: Use generous padding (`p-6` or `p-8`) for major containers. Inside data tables, use tighter spacing (`py-2 px-4`) to maximize information density without feeling cluttered.
layouts.cards: Flat design with crisp 1px borders (`border-stone-200`). Radius should be subtle (`rounded-md` or 6px). Avoid heavy drop shadows; rely on borders for definition.

components.buttons: Slightly rounded (`rounded-md`). Primary buttons have a solid background (`bg-[#A44200]`) with white text. Secondary buttons are outline or subtle filled (`bg-stone-100 text-stone-800 hover:bg-stone-200`).
components.inputs: Shadcn standard but styled with `border-stone-300`, `focus:ring-[#A44200]`, and subtle earthy backgrounds. Never use fully transparent backgrounds for dropdowns.
components.tables: Data-heavy tables must have a sticky header, alternating subtle row colors (`bg-white` and `bg-stone-50`), and clear alignment (numbers right-aligned, text left-aligned).
components.kpi_cards: Top-left quadrant prioritized for primary metrics (Health Score, Wastage %). Include sparklines or clear delta indicators (+/- %).

visual_enhancers.borders: Use grid-style borders to separate data cleanly. The 'Technical' look with `border-collapse` and 1px borders is ideal for operational clarity.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use `shadow-sm` on hover for interactive elements, but keep structural components flat.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Show a subtle earthy illustration or icon with a clear 'Next Best Action' CTA.

motion.guidelines: Keep animations fast and minimal. Micro-interactions on hover (slight background darken) and smooth transitions for sidebar collapse. Avoid bouncy or slow animations.
motion.table_rows: Fade in sequentially on initial load (staggered).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text against background meets APCA standards. Terracotta text over light backgrounds must be bolded if it fails contrast at regular weight.
accessibility.focus: All inputs and buttons must have a visible `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-1 focus:ring-[#A44200]`.

icons.style: Duotone or bold. Use Phosphor Icons for a clean, structural look suitable for data density.

images.description: Moody blurred restaurant scene for the login screen right-panel overlay.
Fresh culinary ingredients, useful for onboarding or 'No Data' screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use `.js` files for React components, NOT `.tsx`.
Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' is imported via a font CDN or standard webfont strategy. Same for 'IBM Plex Sans'.
Implement multi-user auth (mocked) and direct the user to the operational dashboard upon login.
The primary feature is 'Order to be Packed'. Make sure this screen is data-dense, easy to scan, and allows inline editing for 'Delivered' / 'Received' quantities.
Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts for the 'Owner Summary' KPI dashboard, focusing on Line/Bar charts.
Use `data-testid` on all key interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI outputs (e.g., violet/blue gradients). Stick strictly to the Organic & Earthy palette.
Do not center-align the main app layout. Data applications must be left-aligned and structured via a robust grid.
Never use placeholder characters or AI emojis (🤖💡) for icons. Use Phosphor Icons exclusively.
Provide clear feedback (using Sonner toasts) for operations like saving forecast data or updating delivery quantities.
